svg.text: PART A - the register file itself
Fig P4 - Register File and read-port logic: write-back forwarding + x0 forced to zero
Each read port = register-file output -> forward mux (take wb_result if the same register is being written back) -> x0 mux. Select polarity read from your pipeline sketch: verify.
Write happens at the end of WB, so a value written in
the same cycle it is read has not reached the flip-flops yet:
that is why the forward mux exists.
Red wires = write-back signals coming from the WB stage (Fig P6). Green = select signals.
